thread: olivia: Heads-up — mkdocs linkcheck flagged a bunch of broken fragments after the i18n migration. Example: /docs/overview/#client-config jumps to top of page instead of anchor. ci-bot: linkcheck job failed: https://ci.internal/jobs/4823 (exit code 1) nate: repro steps? I scanned the page and headings look fine. could it be the new mdx frontmatter? olivia: I think it's the combination of a trailing HTML comment right after the heading + a table immediately below. mkdocs-slugify seems to drop the slug when heading->comment->table. reproduced locally with latest mkdocs-plugin-anchor (see snippet). mei: can you paste the minimal repro? olivia: sure — minimal: ```md ## Client config | Option | Default | |---|---| Linkcheck resolves anchor to "" slug. works if comment removed or if we add explicit id: ``` samir: ugh. we should avoid inline HTML in docs, but migration scripts added those comments for translators. two options: strip comments before build or force explicit ids on headings. nate: stripping comments sounds safest. do we have anywhere else relying on those i18n hints? olivia: translation infra expects the comments but we can move them to a separate metadata block in frontmatter. low-risk edit. preview-bot: Preview deploy failed for branch fix/docs-anchor-4823 — build log: anchor plugin threw TypeError in slugify at line 212. samir: i'll open a PR that runs a small preprocessor to rewrite `` into frontmatter keys (and adds explicit heading ids as fallback). will tag docs owners for review. olivia: thanks! can you add a regression test to the docs CI to catch comment+table combos? maybe a tiny mkdocs site in tests/fixtures. samir: yep — adding a pytest that runs mkdocs build + linkcheck on a fixture. will ping when PR is up. nate: please add a note in the migration guide so content contributors don't accidentally reintroduce the inline hints. olivia: will update migration docs and add a short blurb in the PR description. samir: PR opened: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/921 (WIP) — tagging @olivia @nate @mei for review. includes preprocessor + test + changelog entry. olivia: review comments left. small nits. once green we can merge and backfill the affected pages (run the preprocessor across the site). docs-ci: linkcheck passed on branch fix/docs-anchor-4823 after preprocessor applied. preview deploy succeeded: https://preview.docs.internal/4823 olivia: merging after a quick smoke test. thanks all :thumbsup:
